description: This file defines theme and color palette functions for a frontend project, providing the Ocean Professional theme tokens and categorical color palettes. It exported functions for retrieving theme tokens, generating color palettes, and mapping categories to colors.

methods.name: getOceanTheme
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens, including colors, typography, radii, and elevation.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette
methods.description: Generates a deterministic, contrast-rich color palette seeded by theme colors for categorical data series, accommodating up to any number of categories.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap
methods.description: Creates a mapping from category names to colors using the categorical palette, maintaining stable order.
